rules.cash: 100000RUB initial cash, wholelots, max25pct perstock, no shorts/leverage
rules.concentration: remove best1and3 positive-PnL origin dates IN HINDSIGHT, all stocks together, rerun remaining account
rules.controls: baseline status/counts/return/drawdown must reproduce published median normal/stress accounts
rules.costs: fixed multipliers1and2 of commission.05pct andslippage.05pct eachperside
rules.interpretation: hindsight sensitivity only; removed dates/quarters are NEVER an implementable new entry rule; no confidence/profit guarantee
rules.limits: same alreadyexamined2024/25/partial2026 prices; no independent validation, dividends, taxes or true execution
rules.missing: selectedunknown poisons account; incomplete baseline gets NO concentration or quarter summaries
rules.policy: fixed median of saved three net forecasts >.10pct, same selected population, no fitting or tuning
rules.quarters: four separate100000RUB quarterly accounts by Moscow origin quarter; plus omit each quarter in whole-year replay
rules.trace: separate daily cash/quantity/PnL reconstruction must reproduce simulator baseline
